lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 10 vertical columns of high-intensity circular blobs, showing higher density and reduced diameter in the ventral-anterior region compared to the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance blobs are aligned at the intersections of faint vertical bands and horizontal rows, forming a distinct grid-like geometric pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 small, high-luminance blobs irregularly spaced within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes characteristic of remoras are visible near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin and the ventral abdominal region.
